items.text: Baker Mayfield (right thumb) will start, Todd Bowles said Friday, after missing three games; he is listed questionable but practiced fully all week. The schedule data lists Jalon Daniels, so the model uses Mayfield.
Final report: Tampa Bay ruled out WR Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot), RT Luke Goedeke (calf) and S Antoine Winfield Jr. (rib); WR Jalen McMillan is on IR.

Final report: Carolina ruled out OLBs Jaelan Phillips (hamstring) and Thomas Incoom (calf); OT Monroe Freeling (knee) and LB Bam Martin-Scott (hamstring) are questionable. Bryce Young has no designation; RB Jonathon Brooks is on IR.

adjust.reason: Tampa Bay is without its top receiver Emeka Egbuka, right tackle Luke Goedeke and safety Antoine Winfield Jr., which outweighs Carolina losing two edge rushers. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
